name: Resonant Power Conversion
description:
- Resonant circuits and their behaviour: voltage and current waveshape using time-domain and state plane analysis, 
- Soft Switching in power converters, Types of soft switching (ZVS, ZCS) and their basic mechanisms
- Soft switching in converters using parasitic resonance, soft switching condition using state plane analysis
- Topologies and Operation of Resonant Converters: Series and parallel resonant converter, LLC and LCC resonant converters and their applications
- Soft switching in resonant converters and their benefits in circuit performance
- Frequency and phase-shift control resonant converters with input voltage and load variations
- Resonant transition converters: operation and advantages
